title: Artifact Grouping Rules
description: Rules engine for grouping artifacts into maps across a sequence. Generates suggested groupings based on tag affinity, size compatibility, complexity gradient, and pedagogical arc. Sequence files store the accepted result as artifact_groups.

sequence_arc.description: Defines how artifact density and complexity change across a sequence's maps. Position is normalized 0.0 (first map) to 1.0 (last map).

positions.name: intro
positions.role: Introduce core concept with minimal artifacts. One main artifact, supporting context objects.

positions.name: foundation
positions.role: Build on intro with related variations. Multiple artifacts from same concept family.

positions.name: exploration
positions.role: Deeper engagement. Mix sizes, introduce interactive challenges. Algorithm isolation maps.

positions.name: integration
positions.role: Combine concepts. Cross-reference earlier artifacts. Hazards test understanding.

positions.name: synthesis
positions.role: Culmination. Callbacks to key artifacts from entire sequence. Large maps, dense placement, thematic resolution.

grouping_factors.description: Weights for computing artifact affinity when suggesting groups.

tag_overlap.description: Artifacts sharing tags belong together. More shared tags = stronger affinity.

size_compatibility.description: Artifacts of similar size_group display well together. Mixing world_scale with compact creates visual imbalance.

complexity_gradient.description: Within a map, complexity should be homogeneous. Mixing basic and advanced creates cognitive dissonance.

interaction_compatibility.description: Maps work best with a dominant interaction mode. Too many modes competing = spatial confusion.

sequence_affinity.description: Artifacts from the same sequence naturally group. Cross-sequence artifacts appear in synthesis maps.

spatial_constraints.description: Hard constraints that override affinity scores.

rules.description: Total footprint area of grouped artifacts must not exceed map usable area minus clearance.
rules.formula: sum(w*d for each artifact) + sum(clearance^2 for each artifact) <= map_width * map_depth * 0.6

rules.description: Tallest artifact height must not exceed map max_height.
scene_embed artifacts get their own map. They cannot share with grid-placed artifacts.
rules.rule: if any artifact has placement=scene_embed, it must be alone in its map

rules.description: At most 1 world_scale artifact per standard map. Large Exhibition can hold 2-3.
Every map should include one dark_sphere as a consistent navigational/thematic anchor.

callback_rules.description: Rules for when artifacts from earlier maps reappear in later maps.

rules.description: Synthesis maps should reference at least 3 artifacts from earlier maps in the sequence.
rules.selection: Pick the most representative artifact from each earlier arc position (intro, foundation, exploration).

rules.description: Integration and synthesis maps may reference artifacts from prerequisite sequences.
rules.condition: Only if sequence has declared prerequisites

rules.description: Callback artifacts may be presented at different scale or context than original appearance.
rules.note: A random_walk_terrarium in its home map is full-size exploration. As a callback in Crisis_Synthesis, it might appear as a miniature citation.

map_templates_by_group.description: Which map template to use based on the group's aggregate footprint and artifact count.

rules.note: Environment artifacts need open space but Template_Basic suffices
Dense synthesis maps need maximum space
No grid map needed, artifact is the world
